description: A brand-new, sparse firm — only a couple of customers, nobody at risk yet, fully identified revenue.

at_risk.definition: customers with 2+ lifetime visits whose last visit is 45-180 days before period end

candidates.label: weekend visit and return pattern
candidates.pattern: Customers who visit on a weekend also tend to return sooner than customers who visit on a weekday.

good:
## Summary
Sparse Sundries is a new shop. Revenue was SGD 200.00 from 2 customers this month.

## What went well
- 1 of 2 customers this month had already bought before, a returning-customer share of 50.0%.
- 100% of revenue came from identified customers.

## What needs attention
- With only 2 customers this month, small numbers can be misleading. No regulars are at risk yet (0 customers).

## Your customers
Your only repeat customer, Ong M., carried all of the identified revenue, SGD 200.00. Customers who visit on a weekend also tend to return sooner than customers who visit on a weekday.

## Do these three things next
1. Keep greeting each of the 2 customers personally next month.
2. Track whether the 1 returning customer comes back again.
3. Watch for the first regular to become at risk after more visits build up.
